ai.title: Include knowledge updates in assistant response
ai.summary: The assistant response now includes an `<extra_knowledge_updates>` block containing file blocks for knowledge changes. This is achieved by awaiting `genKnowledgeFilesPromise` separately, filtering defined changes, and appending the formatted blocks to `fullResponse`. The change is localized to `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`.

eli5.text: When the assistant updates its knowledge files, those changes are now included directly in the assistant's response. Previously, knowledge updates were processed separately without being attached to what the assistant shows you, now, a dedicated section in the response contains the updated knowledge content. This means you see the knowledge changes right inside the assistant's reply, rather than them being handled silently in the background. The change is live today.

ai.title: Fix Windows TS resolution and update package metadata
ai.summary: Updated `backend/tsconfig.json` to include root `node_modules` in `typeRoots` and added `@types/node` to backend devDependencies to resolve Windows module errors. Renamed root package from `manicode-project` to `codebuff-project` and migrated dependencies like `@tanstack/react-query` and `lodash` to `devDependencies`. Added platform-specific guidance to `backend/knowledge.md` and configured `outDir` in `test/tsconfig.json`.

eli5.text: The developers renamed their project from 'manicode-project' to 'codebuff-project' and reorganized some background setup files to improve how Windows users can work with the code. Windows developers were sometimes hitting errors when trying to run the backend locally, and this change fixes the configuration so TypeScript (the tool that checks code correctness) can find the right type definitions across different folder structures on Windows. If you looked at the code today, you'd see the project name has changed in the main configuration file, some developer tools have been moved to the correct category, and there's now documented guidance for Windows users in the knowledge base about handling file paths and module resolution. This is live today for developers working on the codebase,

ai.title: Quota resets every month regardless of usage
ai.summary: Refactored `QuotaManager` interface: replaced `updateQuota` and `resetQuota` with `checkQuota` and `setNextQuota`. Logic moved to `websocket-action.ts` and `middleware.ts` to calculate usage and trigger resets when `nextQuotaReset` passes, independent of quota exhaustion. `AnonymousQuotaManager` now returns `creditsUsed` as string from SQL `SUM`, requiring `parseInt`. Web usage page updated to `use server` and fetches reset date directly.

eli5.text: Your monthly usage limit now resets automatically at the start of each calendar month, even if you haven't used up all your credits yet. Previously, the system only reset your quota after you had exhausted it, causing delays for users who hit their limit at the wrong time. The assistant now checks the date before each use and resets your quota on schedule, without waiting for you to run out of credits first.

ai.title: manicode.ai redirect moved to next.config.mjs
ai.summary: Added `redirects()` in `web/next.config.mjs` to route `manicode.ai` host traffic to `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`. Removed client-side `redirect()` logic from `web/src/app/layout.tsx` RootLayout. Server-side config ensures robust handling without hydration warnings or client-side execution delays.

eli5.text: When someone visits the manicode.ai website, the browser now hands them off to the correct main site at the server level, before the page even tries to draw itself, instead of trying to redirect them after the page loads. You wouldn't see any flickering or error messages during the switch because the redirect happens before the page content appears. The change is live now, so manicode.ai visitors are cleanly routed without the old in-browser redirect logic that could cause delays or warnings.
